p1: I build full-cycle web platforms: microservice architecture and APIs, interfaces, databases, CI/CD and infrastructure. I choose a popular, proven stack — Python and FastAPI, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, message queues, Docker — so the system is reliable today and easy to evolve tomorrow.
p2: An engineer by training (Computer Systems and Networks, diploma with honours). For a long time I combined development with education and headed the Design & Technology department at the Skolkovo International Gymnasium. Now I work in development full time: I build an educational platform for the gymnasium and a system for continuing professional education, and work on projects with startups.

web.title: Web platforms
web.text: Vue.js and FastAPI: user dashboards, admin panels and public services that are easy to evolve.

microservices.title: Microservices & DevOps
microservices.text: Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, CI/CD — reliable infrastructure and predictable releases.

mliot.title: ML & IoT
mliot.text: Computer vision with OpenCV and TensorFlow, devices on Arduino, ESP and Raspberry Pi.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.text: I lead student project teams and create curricula in AI, programming and robotics.

p3: A separate focus of mine is science-intensive projects at the intersection of web, computer vision and hardware — from a grant-funded educational platform for learning machine vision to IoT monitoring systems. As a mentor I lead student project teams from idea to prizes at national competitions.
